info.title: hermod — pick a session from one agent CLI and carry on with it in another.
info.description: hermod — a .NET global tool that moves a stored coding-agent session between CLIs. Pick a conversation Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot CLI recorded in this directory, and carry on with it in a different one: the history is converted into the target's own session store and resumed there, optionally handing the terminal straight to that CLI's interface.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Run it in the directory the work happened in; it lists the sessions each CLI
recorded there, by description rather than by id.

options.name: --from
options.description: skip the source prompt: claude | codex | copilot

options.name: --session
options.description: skip the session prompt (a unique prefix is enough)

options.name: --attach
options.description:
run the target CLI's real TUI in this terminal, with
the profile as flags and the handoff as its first turn

options.name: --handoff
options.description:
the opening turn: `default`, `minimal`, or any literal
template. Beats the config file's "handoff"

options.name: --no-handoff
options.description:
do not send an opening turn: the session opens with
its history and you write the first message yourself

options.name: --summarise
options.description:
replace the conversation with a briefing — always, or
only past n messages. Beats the config file's "summary"

options.name: --no-summarise
options.description: move the real transcript whatever the config says

options.name: --summarise-with
options.description:
`mechanical` (extracted, free), or a profile name: that
<who>            agent reads the transcript and writes the handover

options.name: --summary-prompt
options.description:
what to ask it for. {sourcePath} and {cwd} are filled in
<text>

options.name: --summary-prompt-file
options.description: read that prompt from a file
